options.name: Bleeding Attack
options.benefit: A sneak attack can cause ongoing bleed damage equal to the number of sneak attack dice.

options.name: Combat Trick
options.benefit: Gain one combat feat for which you qualify.

options.name: Fast Stealth
options.benefit: Move at full speed while using Stealth without penalty.

options.name: Finesse Rogue
options.benefit: Gain Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat.

options.name: Ledge Walker
options.benefit: Move at full speed along narrow surfaces without becoming flat-footed.

options.name: Major Magic
options.benefit: Cast one chosen 1st-level sorcerer/wizard spell twice per day as a spell-like ability.

options.name: Minor Magic
options.benefit: Cast one chosen 0-level sorcerer/wizard spell three times per day as a spell-like ability.

options.name: Quick Disable
options.benefit: Disable a trap in half the normal time, or open a lock as a standard action.

options.name: Resiliency
options.benefit: Gain temporary hit points once per day when reduced below 0 hit points.

options.name: Rogue Crawl
options.benefit: Crawl at half speed and take a 5-foot step while prone.

options.name: Slow Reactions
options.benefit: A foe damaged by your sneak attack cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1 round.

options.name: Stand Up
options.benefit: Stand from prone as a free action while still provoking normally.

options.name: Surprise Attack
options.benefit: Treat opponents as flat-footed during the surprise round even if they have acted.

options.name: Trap Spotter
options.benefit: Receive an automatic Perception check when within 10 feet of a trap.

options.name: Weapon Training
options.benefit: Gain Weapon Focus with a chosen weapon as a bonus feat.

options.name: Crippling Strike
options.benefit: Deal 2 points of Strength damage with each sneak attack.

options.name: Defensive Roll
options.benefit: Attempt a Reflex save once per day to halve damage from a potentially lethal blow.

options.name: Dispelling Attack
options.benefit: A sneak attack can dispel an active spell effect on the target.

options.name: Feat
options.benefit: Gain any feat for which you qualify; this advanced talent may be selected multiple times.

options.name: Improved Evasion
options.benefit: Take only half damage on a failed Reflex save against attacks that allow half damage.

options.name: Opportunist
options.benefit: Make one attack of opportunity each round against a foe struck in melee by another character.

options.name: Skill Mastery
options.benefit: Choose 3 plus Intelligence modifier skills and take 10 with them even under stress; this talent may be selected multiple times.

options.name: Slippery Mind
options.benefit: Retry a failed save against an enchantment one round later.
